description:
Get one hire: the worker, the money, what they submitted and what you can do next.
Use for: reviewing the work of one worker, how many photos wait for you, the dispute and the latest message.
Not for: listing every worker on a bounty (list_hires); looking through the photos (list_hire_photos); finding work that waits for review (list_submissions).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_hire({"hireId":"a3Fh8kQz1WpL0mNc"})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

hireId.description: The hire id, from list_hires or accept_application.

name: get_hire

acceptedAt.description: When you accepted the worker. Left out only on an older hire that did not store it.

actions.description: Tools you may call on this hire now. Each tool still checks.

attendance.description: Where the worker is for this round of work, from their phone. Left out on a bounty that is not in person, or before they start sharing. Never coordinates.

lastSeenAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

since.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

anyOf.description: Phone reports but position is old.
Updates pause while the app is in the background.

state.description: Only on_site and off_site establish a position relative to the site.

cost.description: What this hire costs you as its held money stands now: pay plus service fee. Left out when nothing is held: the fee of a pay-later hire is set when you pay.

openedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

at.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

endedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

isLatestMessageHidden.description: true when the chat could not be shown because the money record this hire points at could not be proven: a message may exist. Left out otherwise.

latestMessage.description: The newest chat message you can see, once the worker has submitted work. Left out before that, when there is none, and when isLatestMessageHidden is true.

sentAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

paidAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

pay.description: The worker's pay for this hire, bonuses included: base pay plus the most the bonuses can pay until they are decided, then base pay plus the bonuses earned. Left out only when it cannot be read: every hire has pay.

payStatus.description: Where the money stands. paid means it was released to the worker and left your side for good; it does not say the worker's balance was credited yet.

status.description: offered: waiting for the worker to confirm. active: working, or fixing a redo. submitted: work waits for your review, or the work is done and its pay waits for you to release or pay it. paid: the pay was released to the worker. disputed: the money is held until the platform settles it. ended: the hire is over without pay, see endedReason.

submission.description: The work the worker sent for this hire. Left out before they submit; a draft is never shown.

appealDueAt.description: After a reject: the worker may appeal until then.

max.description: The most redos you may ask.

checks.description: What the automatic checks found. Advisory only: it never approves or pays.

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

isLiveCapture.description: Taken with the in-app camera at the time of the work.

photos.description: How many photos of a photo bounty are in each state. Read the photos with list_hire_photos. Left out on other bounties.

redoDueAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

decidedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.
ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

worker.description: The hired worker. id or name is left out only on an older hire that did not store it.

title: Get a hire
